title: Activating fastDecisionAI
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
Request a License Key

  1. As part of activating fastDecisionAI, you need to request a license key

  2. When received, please save this license key, as it can be used again if you change computers

  3. Now, start fastDecisionAI

  4. Click File > fastDecisionAI Info (see screen below)

  5. Click License Request to generate a unique code

  6. Use the Copy Button to copy and then send the code to contact@lateralworks.com

Activate fastDecisionAI

  1. On receipt of your license key, open fastDecisionAI

  2. Click File > fastDecisionAI Info (see screen below)

  3. Click Activate

  4. Enter (or paste) the license key
